explanation: The statement says that the q-expansion f of a Γ₀(ℓ)-invariant function is integral over ℚ[jq], the subalgebra of Laurent series generated by the q-expansion of j. jq and the helpers the proof calls (isIntegral_of_data, sigma, sigma_zeta) are the library's own definitions. Mathlib only provides generic cyclotomic-field instances, which the proof uses as glue. I grepped Mathlib for a j-invariant or a modular function field and got only two false-positive files, StoneWeierstrass and Fourier/AddCircle. Mathlib has no integrality result over ℚ[j] for q-expansions.
